summary: The plan replaces the main database and opens SSH on the web security group to the internet. Review the database replacement first: deletion protection and the final snapshot are both being turned off at the same time.

likely_causes.cause: module.database.aws_db_instance.main will be destroyed and re-created because its identifier changes, and deletion protection and the final snapshot are turned off, so existing data is likely lost unless it is migrated.
aws_security_group.web gains an ingress rule that allows SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0, the whole internet.
aws_instance.app user data now exports a database password in plain text.
The database engine is upgraded to a new major version.

next_checks: Is a data migration, snapshot restore or moved block planned for module.database.aws_db_instance.main?
Should SSH on aws_security_group.web be limited to a VPN or bastion range instead of 0.0.0.0/0?
Can the database password in aws_instance.app user data come from a secrets manager instead?
suggested_change: Keep the old identifier (or add a moved block) so the database is updated in place, keep deletion_protection = true, and restrict the SSH rule to an internal CIDR.
